batches.objective: Identify the largest avoidable native submission cost in unchanged UMAP and retain or reject one correction in its actual owner.
batches.rationale: The complete-operation report rejects current-source native-addon optimization. Public and driver timelines locate substantial synchronous submission time but do not yet identify its recoverable portion. GPU duration probes have no calibrated host origin; do not infer a disjoint cost by subtraction. Preserve the identifier repair and rejected hoisting/subgroup experiments.
batches.nextAction: Attribute binding preparation, synchronization preparation and driver work inside ordinary native submission before choosing a correction. Preserve identifier admission, pending-resource lifetimes, rejected hoisting/subgroup changes and unresolved compiler timing samples.
acceptance: Numerical, bounds and alias semantics are preserved through independent physical output oracles; existing runtime and full WGSL suites pass.

Compiler time and allocations, generated-program execution time, full application latency and memory are measured independently against the accepted baseline and pinned Dawn, with declared regression limits and every cohort retained.
batches.stopCondition: Retain one owned correction only after frozen correctness, replay and complete-operation acceptance, or reject it with all cohorts retained. Vulkan remains active; no shader transformation is required by this batch.
requiredEnvironment: Physical AMD Vulkan provider and existing native phase diagnostics
Pinned Dawn control and unchanged application inputs
